name: skillforge
description: 面向 AI 辅助开发的技能集：单一 /dev 入口、确定性的 Go 质量门禁、与语言无关的迭代账本，共 21 个技能。

interface.shortDescription: Deterministic dev workflow skills with exit-code verdicts
interface.longDescription: Skillforge bundles 21 skills for AI-assisted development. Three of them form the flow layer: dev answers what to do next, go-gate answers whether this version is correct through build/vet/test/race/lint/bench exit codes, and loop answers whether the version is worth keeping through a metric ledger. The rest are capability skills loaded on demand.
